reviews.review_description: Airborne Heroes: WW2 Shooter is an incredible WWII VR shooter on Meta Quest! Jumping into the intense single-player campaign and manually aiming and reloading historical weapons with your own hands is super immersive and fun. Even though it’s still in development (levels past 30 are on the way and two-handed machine guns take some getting used to), the solo action is already fantastic and a must-try for VR shooter fans!

This game is in early access so you can expect it to need work before it is finished, but it does have great potential.  Some of the problems mostly have to do with the physics. Example: If you have a large gun on your chest (available later in the game) It interferes with the handling of the pistol and grabbing the megs of bullets. If you don't have your arms completely stretched out as far as you can, the pistol may suddenly aim in the wrong direction, or you will not be able to grab the bullets when needed. We need to be able to place the holsters for all the guns were best for us. The bombs were so far to the right, I would have to completely turn my body just to see them. They were also too close together, so when you reached for one thing, you typically got something else and had to try again and again. Same with the rocket launcher, so far left making it hard to grab.  The enemies need to be staggered and different each time, and more of them in each round.  When you are getting your mission, the text on the screen moves around the screen. It should always be placed directly in front of the player and never move until it is done being read.  I don't think the red arrows on the ground is necessary. The yellow circle for the movement spot is fine.  There should be a bonus if you make it through a run without taking any damage.  I finished all 30 levels (on easy) in less than 4 hours.
Amazing i absolutely love world war two and this game was really fun to play and stuff i recommend it
